_what: Measured per-file pytest wall seconds. Read by tools/battery/fastfix.py to sort a selection cheapest-first and to price it. Regenerate with `python tools/battery/fastfix.py --base <ref> --record`.
_why: Audit finding G11: tests/test_health_field_census.py documented its own cost as 'about 65 s' and measured 541 s. Nothing in the project measured test cost, so the fast/slow tier split was maintained from stale prose. A number in a tracked file is harder to be wrong about for a year than a sentence in a docstring.
_how: GPUWM_NO_LOCAL_GPU=1 PYTHONSAFEPATH=1, one file per pytest invocation, Windows cut box, venv with cupy + setuptools + the render extra. Process spawn is dearer on Windows than on a Linux node: tests/test_gpu_marker_discipline.py measured 311 s here against 122 s on a Linux node before this branch changed it. Treat these as the cut box's numbers.
_measured: 2026-08-13, branch lane/battery-fastfix, after the tier split and the collection reuse. tilestream/ rows added 2026-08-16 (release blocker #5): same one-file-per-invocation method on the Windows cut box; the three gpu-shard files (test_gather/test_graphcap/test_hoststore) were timed WITH the card since under GPUWM_NO_LOCAL_GPU=1 they are all-skip and the number would price nothing.
